description: This Java source file defines the class GroovyScriptAssert, a custom test assertion class that extends GroovyAssert for testing Groovy scripts within the Apache OFBiz framework. It contains private fields for Delegator, LocalDispatcher, and Security, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: GroovyScriptAssert
classes.description: A test assertion class for executing Groovy scripts without compilation in the OFBiz framework, extending GroovyAssert and encapsulating delegator, dispatcher, and security components.
